sections.heading: MINOR IN FILM STUDIES
lines: Faculty of Arts and Humanities - Film Studies
The Minor in Film Studies is intended for students who want a rigorous program of film study compatible with potential upgrading to Major and Honours Specialization modules in Film Studies.
Completion of first-year requirements, including Film Studies 1000-1999 with a mark of at least 60%.
1.0 course in Film Studies from: Film Studies 2252F/G, Film Studies 2254F/G, Film Studies 2258F/G, the former Film Studies 2230F/G.
3.0 additional courses in Film Studies or approved courses offered by other Departments or Faculties. No more than 1.0 of these courses may be at the at the 2100 level.
